nodes.summary: Two standard Young tableaux of the same skew shape with the same entries are equal; the other fields of the structure are proofs. This is what makes the set of tableaux finite: a tableau is a function on the finitely many cells with values in $\{1, \dots, n\}$.
nodes.title: Tableaux are determined by their entries

nodes.summary: Every cell of a Young diagram has hook length at least $1$, since the hook contains the cell itself. In particular the product of the hook lengths in the hook length formula is positive.
nodes.title: Hook lengths are positive

nodes.summary: For a cell $u = (i, j)$ of the Young diagram of $\lambda$, the hook of $u$ consists of $u$, the cells to its right in row $i$ and the cells below it in column $j$. Its size is the hook length
nodes.title: Hook length of a cell

nodes.summary: A Young diagram $\lambda$ is viewed as the skew shape $\lambda / \varnothing$, so that the standard Young tableaux of skew shape $\lambda/\varnothing$ are the standard Young tableaux of shape $\lambda$.
nodes.title: Straight shape as a skew shape
Sum of the squares of the numbers of standard Young tableaux

nodes.summary: $f^\lambda$ is the number of standard Young tableaux of shape $\lambda$: fillings of the $n = |\lambda|$ cells of the diagram with $1, 2, \dots, n$, each used once, increasing along each row and down each column. In Lean it is the cardinality of the type of standard Young tableaux of skew shape $\lambda/\varnothing$, which is finite (an instance in the same module), so $f^\lambda$ is a genuine count. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
